rotifer-guide v1.2.2

- Pins Rotifer CLI to version 0.26.0 and MCP server to 0.17.0 for all commands and instructions, updating all user guidance and prerequisite checks accordingly.
- Updates related skill references to use new consistent prefixes (e.g., `rotifer-gene`, `rotifer-genome`).
- Improves CLI usage recommendations for reproducibility and reviewability, including lockfile and integrity guidance.
- Removes deprecated file: skill-card.md.
- Documentation and manifest updates to clarify exact versioning, installation, and routing behaviors.

rotifer-guide v1.2.1

- Improved intent routing: clearer guidance for when and how this skill should be invoked.
- Updated onboarding and scaffold documentation for accuracy and concise user signals.
- Clarified that this skill only operates in Rotifer contexts, preventing accidental invocation for non-Rotifer scenarios. 
- Minor edits for precision and directness in workflow descriptions.

rotifer-guide v1.2.0

- Clarified intended use: not for general onboarding, tutorials, troubleshooting, or search — Rotifer Genes/CLI only.
- Updated SKILL.md description and instructions for clearer scope boundaries.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core workflow or sub-capabilities (onboarding, scaffold, doctor, explorer, upgrade).
- Minor refinements to explanations, user prompts, and fallback logic.

rotifer-guide 1.1.1

- Added an explicit section detailing exactly what this Skill does on your machine, including which commands it runs, what it reads/writes, and when it sends data to the cloud.
- Clarified in the scaffold (natural-language scaffolding) section that Path A transmits user content to rotifer.ai, and that local CLI fallback does not; users are prompted to confirm when content is sent online.
- Enhanced transparency and user control by stating that commands which install, publish, or overwrite are only run with user approval.
- No core workflow or command changes; all flows remain as before.
- Documentation improvements for clarity and user privacy awareness.

rotifer-guide v1.1.0

- Adds explicit Web Studio (rotifer.ai) workflow for LLM-backed scaffolding, including backend API endpoints and offline CLI fallback.
- Updates onboarding to default to `rotifer hello` for fastest demo, and clarifies prerequisites and troubleshooting (e.g., `rotifer doctor`).
- Improves clarity on when to use backend vs CLI for scaffold, showing network-aware instructions.
- Clarifies and modernizes intent routing and related skills, with new references to `gene` modules.
- Removes the obsolete skill-card and streamlines examples and next-step guidance.
